question: Which undersea defence weapon was successfully trialed by the Indian Navy in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Multi-Influence Ground Mine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Multi-Influence Ground Mine** is an advanced undersea weapon system designed to neutralize enemy naval assets. It is one of the most sophisticated mine systems developed for modern naval warfare.
 
• It was successfully trialed by the **Indian Navy** in **May 2025**, highlighting the country's advancements in indigenous defense technology and undersea warfare capabilities.
 
• This mine operates based on multiple influence parameters such as acoustic, magnetic, and pressure signatures, making it highly effective against a wide range of targets like submarines and surface ships.
 
• It enhances the capability of the Indian Navy in **anti-submarine warfare** and coastal defense, ensuring strategic maritime security in critical zones like the Indian Ocean Region (IOR).
 
• The development and deployment of such mines reflect India's focus on achieving self-reliance in defense technology under the **‘Make in India’ initiative**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Multi-Influence Ground Mine:**

 
 
• This mine uses **multi-influence sensors** to detect and classify targets based on their specific acoustic, magnetic, and pressure signatures.
 
• It can be deployed in shallow or deep waters, making it versatile for different maritime environments.
 
• These mines are equipped with **programmable settings**, allowing operators to tailor their activation criteria to specific threats.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Undersea Defense Weapons:**
 
 
• Undersea defense weapons like the Multi-Influence Ground Mine play a crucial role in safeguarding a nation’s maritime borders.
 
• They act as a deterrent against enemy naval incursions and provide a tactical advantage in **anti-access/area denial (A2/AD) strategies**.
 
 
 
• **Other Indian Naval Advancements:**
 
 
• The Indian Navy has been focusing on enhancing its underwater warfare capabilities with assets like the **INS Kalvari-class submarines** and advanced torpedoes like **Varunastra**.
 
• Collaborations with nations such as Russia, France, and the US have also contributed to the development of indigenous defense technologies.
 
 
 
• **‘Make in India’ Initiative in Defense:**
 
 
• Launched in **2014**, the ‘Make in India’ initiative aims to transform India into a global design and manufacturing hub.
 
• In defense, it emphasizes indigenization of military equipment, reducing dependency on imports, and boosting domestic production capabilities.
 
• Projects like the Multi-Influence Ground Mine highlight the success of this initiative in the defense sector.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Comparison with Other Options:**

 
 
• **Deep-Sea Explosive:** Generally refers to underwater explosives used for demolition tasks, not a specific naval defense weapon.
 
• **Hydro Depth Torpedo:** Likely a reference to torpedoes used against deep-sea targets; however, it does not align with the trialed weapon.
 
• **Submarine Neutralizer:** Refers to systems designed specifically to disable submarines, but it is not the correct answer here.
